title: Under Armour and Feng Chen Wang Bring Rebel Daughter to China, Celebrating the Power of Modern Women
summary: Rebel Daughter reflects Under Armour and Feng Chen Wang's shared understanding of contemporary women's strength. It is a strength expressed not only through speed, power and performance, but also through the confidence to challenge convention and embrace change. Rooted in tradition yet unbound by it, these women carve out their own paths without seeking to fit in or be defined. Different by nature and connected by choice, they rise together as Rebel Daughters
body_markdown:
Following the announcement of their long-term creative partnership at Paris Fashion Week in June, Under Armour and Feng Chen Wang presented them Rebel Daughter collection in Shanghai on October 14 under the theme “One of One. Never Alone.” Marking the collection's first full presentation in China, the event brought together Under Armour's performance innovation and Feng Chen Wang's creative vision, expanding the dialogue between sport, culture and contemporary design.


Rebel Daughter reflects Under Armour and Feng Chen Wang's shared understanding of contemporary women's strength. It is a strength expressed not only through speed, power and performance, but also through the confidence to challenge convention and embrace change. Rooted in tradition yet unbound by it, these women carve out their own paths without seeking to fit in or be defined. Different by nature and connected by choice, they rise together as Rebel Daughters.
